findings.problem: The sealed jinshu/047 date packet still contains 47 unresolved temporal items (reign-undated reforms, retrospective exemplars, sexagenary-only days, Sima Liang regency without numbered year, and similar). These blocks prevent native status=audited approval under PEOPLE_DATE_AUDIT.
findings.action: Owner should batch-repair only representation errors: convert pure undated source facts to undatedSourceAttestation where no calendar text exists; for reign-context events, attach host-supplied mapped westernBounds with hashed witnesses. Do not invent years. Then rebuild the packet for a fresh complete independent audit.
